info.title: OEC Registry – MQTT interface
info.description: The MQTT interface of the OEC Registry D5 (ADR-0029 §8): the Registry services of MG A1 (REQ-REG-002), its own lifecycle (MG 6.3) and the subscriptions and read-only Get requests it uses to collect the MAM and Health of the assets (REQ-REG-001, ADR-0008). Increment 1 (C-086). The further resources served at Messaging Level 2 and higher (Profile, PublicationList, SubscriptionList, ReferenceDesignation, Event) follow in increment 2. Payloads are the NetworkMessages of the OEC JSON Schema D1, referenced by their $id.

externalDocs.description: OEC Messaging Guideline, Annex A1 OEC Registry

broker.description: The Message Bus of the OEC platform; address and port from broker.json (RIG 4.1.1, MG 6.2.2), TLS, QoS and retain as in MG 6.3.
Address of the broker (DNS name or IP address of broker.json).

getMam.description: Registry service: requests the MAM of every available asset (MG A1, REQ-REG-002).

appId.description: The AppId: the Identification Link of the OEC Registry itself, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

getMamSource.description: Registry service: requests the MAM of one available asset (MG A1, REQ-REG-002).

appId.description: The AppId: the Identification Link of the OEC Registry itself, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

source.description: The Source: the Identification Link of the described asset, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

pubMam.description: The MAM of the registry and of every available asset, one DataSetMessage each, answering Get/MAM (ReplyTo set).

appId.description: The AppId: the Identification Link of the OEC Registry itself, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

pubMamSource.description: The MAM of one asset: of the registry itself (Birth without ReplyTo, MG 6.3.3; a change of its MAM) or of an available asset answering Get/MAM/<Source>.

appId.description: The AppId: the Identification Link of the OEC Registry itself, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

source.description: The Source: the Identification Link of the described asset, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

getHealth.description: Registry service: requests the Health of every available asset (MG A1, REQ-REG-002).

appId.description: The AppId: the Identification Link of the OEC Registry itself, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

getHealthSource.description: Registry service: requests the Health of one available asset (MG A1, REQ-REG-002).

appId.description: The AppId: the Identification Link of the OEC Registry itself, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

source.description: The Source: the Identification Link of the described asset, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

pubHealth.description: The Health of the registry and of every available asset, one DataSetMessage each, answering Get/Health (ReplyTo set).

appId.description: The AppId: the Identification Link of the OEC Registry itself, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

pubHealthSource.description: The Health of one asset: of the registry itself (heartbeat at least every 60 s, Close NORMAL_0/0, Will FAILURE_1/0 sent by the broker; MG 6.3, MG 7.5.1) or of an available asset answering Get/Health/<Source>.

appId.description: The AppId: the Identification Link of the OEC Registry itself, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

source.description: The Source: the Identification Link of the described asset, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

assetMam.description: The MAM published by any application about itself or a represented asset (subscribed as Oi4v2/+/+/Pub/MAM/#); a MAM about itself without ReplyTo is its Birth (REQ-REG-001).

otherAppId.description: The AppId of another application, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

source.description: The Source: the Identification Link of the described asset, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

assetHealth.description: The Health published by any application about itself or a represented asset (subscribed as Oi4v2/+/+/Pub/Health/#); NORMAL_0/0 about itself is its Close, FAILURE_1/0 its Will (REQ-REG-001).

otherAppId.description: The AppId of another application, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

source.description: The Source: the Identification Link of the described asset, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

otherGetMam.description: The registry asks an application for the MAM of itself and its represented assets when it lacks one (ADR-0029 §4); the answer arrives on assetMam.

otherAppId.description: The AppId of another application, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

otherGetHealth.description: The registry asks an application for the Health of itself and its represented assets when it lacks one (ADR-0029 §4); the answer arrives on assetHealth.

otherAppId.description: The AppId of another application, base64url-encoded as one topic level (MG 4.3).

serveMam.summary: Registry service Get/MAM: answered with the MAM of the registry and of every available asset.

serveMamSource.summary: Registry service Get/MAM/<Source>: answered with the MAM of that asset; an unknown or unavailable Source is answered with a Status event BadNotFound (REQ-CMP-047).

serveHealth.summary: Registry service Get/Health: answered with the Health of the registry and of every available asset.

serveHealthSource.summary: Registry service Get/Health/<Source>: answered with the Health of that asset; an unknown or unavailable Source is answered with a Status event BadNotFound (REQ-CMP-047).

publishMam.summary: Birth of the registry (its MAM without ReplyTo after the connect, MG 6.3.3) and a change of its MAM.

publishHealth.summary: Health of the registry: after the Birth, on change, the heartbeat at least every 60 s (SF-106), the Close NORMAL_0/0 before the disconnect; the broker sends the Will FAILURE_1/0.

collectMam.summary: Collects the MAM of every asset (REQ-REG-001).

collectHealth.summary: Collects the Health of every asset (REQ-REG-001).

requestMam.summary: Read-only request (ADR-0008): Get/MAM to an application whose MAM or whose assets' MAM is missing.

requestHealth.summary: Read-only request (ADR-0008): Get/Health to an application whose Health or whose assets' Health is missing.
